sane.definition: a. mentally healthy; free from mental disorder
sane.translation:
a. 神智健全的, 稳健的, 没病的, 合理的
[医] 精神健全的

sanely.definition:
r. with good sense or in a reasonable or intelligent manner
r. in a sane or lucid manner
sanely.translation: adv. 稳健地；心智健全地；理智地

saneness.definition: n. The state of being sane; sanity.
saneness.translation: n. 心智健全, 稳健

saner.definition:
a. mentally healthy; free from mental disorder
s. marked by sound judgment
saner.translation: a. 心智健全的( sane的比较级 ); 神志正常的; 明智的; 稳健的

sanest.definition:
a. mentally healthy; free from mental disorder
s. marked by sound judgment
sanest.translation: a. 心智健全的( sane的最高级 ); 神志正常的; 明智的; 稳健的
